ارتعدوا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَعَدُوا (irtaʕadū) /ir.ta.ʕa.duː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَعَدَ (irtaʕada)
# اِرْتَعِدُوا (irtaʕidū) /ir.ta.ʕi.duː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِرْتَعَدَ (irtaʕada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
